If you’re trying to build social reputation onchain via memecoins, you will inevitably fail.

If you hold, you roundtrip, losing life changing money and reputation at the same time.

If you sell, you might lock in a quick profit but you lose credibility and integrity.

The only way to build both lasting reputation and lasting wealth is to invest in fundamentally strong onchain businesses that generate real value over time, the kind worth holding on to.

In the beginning progress might feel slow while everyone’s chasing casino shitters, but once those effects start compounding, it can go real quick.

Just imagine there is a future Warren Buffett out there right now, investing fully transparently onchain, and people are most likely ignoring him because his calls look too lame short term.

it’ll be painfully obvious in hindsight.

#Uranium #Silver #Copper #Gold

THE DAILY METALS PULSE — SEPTEMBER 5, 2026 ⚒️

The market just stress-tested my four metals.

A much stronger-than-expected US jobs report lifted the dollar and yields, hitting precious metals, but the underlying picture remains constructive.

☢️ Uranium: ~$89.50/lb
August spot closed at $89.75, up $3.25, while the blended long-term price reached a record $96.50/lb. Quiet spot market, increasingly loud contracting signal.

🥈 Silver: $66.05/oz
Down around 1.4% Friday and for the week, but still up more than 12% over the past month. One hot data print trimmed the rally; it did not erase the breakout.

🥉 Copper: $6.58/lb
Essentially flat Friday and still within 4% of August’s record high. Holding this firmly despite rising yields and a stronger dollar speaks volumes about the tight physical market.

🥇 Gold: ~$4,419/oz
Down 1.2% as 162,000 new jobs revived Fed-hike expectations. Yet gold defended $4,400 despite one of the strongest macro headwinds it could face.

Next week’s US inflation data will determine the short-term direction. But Friday changed rate expectations—it did not create new copper supply, close uranium’s contracting gap or remove the monetary case for precious metals.

The secular metals bull market remains intact.

tweets.text:
The launch of OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra marks a clear transition in AI capabilities: moving from copilot assistance (generating text and code) towards direct computer control (executing multi-step workflows across applications, terminals, and browsers).  

While the technical jump is substantial, deployment remains gated under enterprise admin controls and access restrictions; meaning adoption will be measured, not overnight.  

Investment Implications: 

Legacy SaaS (Value Compression): Seat-based SaaS pricing faces structural pressure as agents execute workflows that previously required individual user seats. Mid-tier apps acting primarily as thin GUIs risk being reduced to low-margin systems of record.  

Inference & Power (Structural Demand): Multi-step, agentic execution increases token volume and compute per completed job relative to single-prompt queries. This sustains high capital intensity across compute, networking and energy infrastructure.  

Context & Governance Holders (Durable Moats): Models require live operational context to act safely. Value and pricing power accrue to platforms that control proprietary enterprise data, identity, permissions and audit logs.  

Bottom Line: Value is likely to shift away from thin middle-layer application software, concentrating instead in underlying compute and power infrastructure and in the platform layers governing enterprise execution.
